novelty_basis: The sign of the left regular representation is classical; its use as an obstruction for full Fibonacci periods was not found (searches as for CLM-C16-05; Fibonacci lengths of groups - Knox, Fibonacci Quart. 30 (1992) 116-120; Campbell-Campbell, Irish Math. Soc. Bull. 56 (2005) - study generating pairs, not full periods). Small.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C16.md Theorem 7, parity of the regular representation via Burnside's normal 2-complement theorem); consistent with 18000 random isotopes of the nine groups of order 4, 6, 8 (EXP-C16-02); awaiting independent skeptic review
statement: For every group G of even order n = 2m and every isotope x o y = gamma(alpha(x) beta(y)), prod_b sgn(L_b) = (-1)^m, whereas a full period requires (-1)^(m+1); so no group of even order and no isotope of one is full-period. (For odd n isotopes of Z_n are full-period for every n = 5, ..., 15.)
title: No isotope of a group of even order has a full-period Fibonacci pair map
